safe_special_filter_lemma.consequence: Only special-meeting branch blocker rows are filtered to orders four and five. Isolate-only rows are never filtered before the two branches are coupled.
safe_special_filter_lemma.proof: The row r hits its own branch by definition and the opposite branch because every opposite complement contains both branch specials. For each v in r, branch minimality supplies a branch triple disjoint from r without v; adjoining the opposite two-set remains disjoint because r contains none of those vertices. Thus every deletion of v fails globally.
safe_special_filter_lemma.statement: If r is a minimal transversal of one branch triple clutter and r meets a special of that branch, then r is a minimal transversal of the full coupled facet-complement clutter.
